claim: Xin Rong Ji earned three Michelin stars in Beijing's inaugural 2020 guide, making it the city's first-ever three-star restaurant
quote: Michelin Guide Beijing gives three stars to Xin Rong Ji in inaugural list of city's best restaurants

claim: Taizhou cuisine earned nine stars in the 2026 Beijing Michelin Guide; Xin Rong Ji has held three stars for seven consecutive years
quote: Taizhou cuisine earns nine stars in 2026 Beijing Michelin Guide

claim: Xin Rong Ji's 28-day-old baby Peking duck is available only at the Xinyuan South Road flagship branch and requires advance pre-order; tasting menu ¥1,850–2,580 + 15% service charge; wine pairing ¥498
quote: The 28-day-old baby Peking duck, which you have to pre-order, is available exclusively at this location

claim: Chao Shang Chao was the first Teochew restaurant to earn three Michelin stars in Beijing, awarded in 2024
quote: The MICHELIN Guide Beijing 2024: First Restaurant Offering Teochew Specialties is Awarded Three MICHELIN Stars

claim: Chef Yat Fung Cheung of Chao Shang Chao won the inaugural Beijing Michelin Mentor Chef Award in 2026; Blackswan and Lamdre were promoted to two stars
quote: Chef Yat Fung CHEUNG, at the helm of the culinary team at Three MICHELIN Stars Restaurant Chao Shang Chao, has been honored with the inaugural Beijing MICHELIN Mentor Chef Award

claim: Chao Shang Chao tasting menu ¥1,888/person + ¥498 wine pairing; restaurant occupies 4F of CP Center with no other tenants; English menu and staff available; signature dishes include braised fish maw and pigeon two ways
quote: Tasting menu: 1,888 CNY per person. Wine pairing: 498 CNY per person

claim: Lamdre ranked #17 at Asia's 50 Best Restaurants 2026 and won the Highest Climber Award, jumping 33 places
quote: Lamdre | Asia's 50 Best Restaurants 2026 | Ranked No. 17

claim: Lamdre is the only Beijing restaurant in Asia's 50 Best Restaurants 2026 and the first Beijing restaurant to rank in the top 20
quote: Lamdre Becomes Only Beijing Entry in Asia's 50 Best Restaurants 2026

claim: Chef Dai Jun has 30+ years of culinary experience in Cantonese and Chaozhou cooking and spent time in Japan studying plant-based ingredients
quote: Chef Dai Jun has more than three decades of professional cooking under his belt, having come up through kitchens in five-star hotels and being classically trained in Cantonese and Chaozhou cuisine

claim: Lamdre's signature dishes include the sunflower appetizer (hawthorn cake, green apple, sweetcorn purée) and the 'All About Soy' tofu showcase with house-made fermented tofu
quote: An appetizer featuring hawthorn cake, green apple, and sweetcorn purée, designed to resemble an actual sunflower

claim: Chef Vianney Massot trained under Joël Robuchon for nearly a decade and was responsible for menu development for Robuchon's global establishments; Blackswan is set inside Luohong Art Museum
quote: Chef Vianney Massot began his career at the prestigious Épicure in Paris before joining Joël Robuchon, where he spent nearly a decade in his laboratory

claim: Blackswan offers two fixed menus: Harmony (6-course, ¥1,680) and Freedom (3-course, ¥1,080); address is 1F Luohong Art Museum, 89 Capital Airport Road, Shunyi
quote: Harmony: 6-course menu at ¥1,680 and Freedom: 3-course menu with dessert at ¥1,080

claim: King's Joy lost its three-star status in the 2025 Michelin Guide; it was the first vegetarian restaurant to earn three stars (2020) and retains the Green Star
quote: King's Joy Loses Three Michelin Star Status in 2025 Guide

claim: King's Joy tasting menus range ¥999–3,999; three lacto-ovo menus of 10+ courses all adaptable to vegan; menu must be selected at booking time; capacity ~220 seats
quote: The tasting menu ranges from 999-3,999 CNY

claim: Jingji at The Ritz-Carlton Beijing specialises in royal cuisine honouring imperial banquet traditions; name is a portmanteau of Beijing and Yueji (city flower)
quote: Jingji specialises in royal cuisine that not only pays homage to the nation's culinary traditions, but also captures the essence of regional recipes

claim: Lu Shang Lu specialises in Shandong Confucius cuisine with live seafood shipped daily from the Jiaodong Peninsula; earned two stars in 2025
quote: The speciality at Lu Shang Lu is Shandong cooking, especially Confucius cuisine, sea cucumber and live seafood shipped daily from Jiaodong peninsula

claim: Shanghai Cuisine brings authentic Shanghainese cooking to Beijing with a head chef and team from Shanghai sourcing seasonal Jiangzhe ingredients
quote: Michelin-starred Shanghai Cuisine opens restaurant in Beijing

claim: The 2026 Michelin Guide Beijing contains 99 total starred restaurants with 2 three-star and 6 two-star restaurants; two new two-star promotions were Blackswan and Lamdre
quote: New edition of the MICHELIN Guide Beijing 2026 — New Stars Rise, Mentor Chef Award Debuts in Mainland China

claim: The Michelin Guide Beijing 2026 was officially released on 31 October 2025
